title: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration…
description: A vulnerability in the UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin for WordPress before version 2.26.16.26 allows unauthenticated attackers to inject escaped markup that becomes stored cross-site scripting (XSS) when an administrator restores the database to a new address or server.
